name: exifview
description: Browser extension for viewing EXIF, IPTC, XMP, and ICC metadata from images

scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: npm run bundle:chrome && npm run manifest:chrome && npm run copy-static:chrome
scripts.build:firefox: npm run bundle:firefox && npm run manifest:firefox && npm run copy-static:firefox
scripts.copy-static:chrome: cp static/*.html static/*.css build/chrome/ && cp -r static/icons build/chrome/
scripts.copy-static:firefox: cp static/*.html static/*.css build/firefox/ && cp -r static/icons build/firefox/
